items.tradition: Chinese oracle-bone script; modern vector redraw based on cited Hanziyuan and Academia Sinica character images
items.caption: An oracle-bone style form of 車 has a long central shaft crossed by a bar, with a vehicle body and wheel-like shapes below. Early forms varied in which vehicle features they showed.
items.alt: Black oracle-bone style character with a vertical central stroke, a broad crossbar, and a lower section containing several openings.
items.selection_reason: Provides a clear early pictorial example consistent with descriptions of variable vehicle features in oracle-bone forms.
items.rights: CC0 / public-domain dedication stated on the Commons page.

items.tradition: Chinese bronze-inscription script; modern vector redraw keyed to the cited 同卣 inscription image
items.caption: This Western Zhou bronze-script form of 車 has a crossbar above a framed middle section divided into openings, with a long vertical stroke continuing below.
items.alt: Black bronze-script character with a crossbar, a box-like middle divided into four openings, and a long vertical stroke.
items.selection_reason: Shows a distinct bronze-inscription form that helps illustrate the graph’s changing visual presentation; its specific inscription association is identified as a modern redraw.
items.rights: CC0 / public-domain dedication stated on the Commons page.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition; transmitted dictionary form, compiled c. 100 CE
items.tradition: Chinese seal script; modern vector redraw referencing Hanziyuan and Academia Sinica
items.caption: The seal-script form associated with the Shuowen tradition has a regular framed center crossed by horizontal strokes, with a vertical line extending above and below.
items.alt: Black seal-script character with a rectangular center, horizontal crossbars, and a vertical stroke extending past both ends.
items.selection_reason: Adds a legible seal-script example of the pictographic graph in a regularized form.
items.rights: Public-domain dedication stated on the Commons page.

limitations.text: These images are modern vector redrawings of script forms, not photographs of inscribed artifacts; individual vehicle parts in a particular drawing should be treated cautiously.
Oracle-bone examples are reported with inscription identifiers, but the cited evidence does not give calendar dates for those individual inscriptions.
